# GitHub Repository Metadata

Use these values in the GitHub repository **About** panel to improve search discovery.

## Description

AI spam call detection and TRAI DND reporting voice agent for India using LiveKit, Sarvam STT/TTS, Gemini/OpenAI, SIP telephony, and Telegram alerts.

## Website

If the Render TRAI confirmation page is public, you can set the website field to:

```text
https://spamdetection-report.onrender.com
```

Otherwise leave the website empty until there is a product/demo page.
